title: World War II Memorial vandalized with spray paint on National Mall
summary: World War II Memorial on the National Mall was vandalized with pink spray paint. U.S. Park Police are investigating and the Department of Interior called it an 'utter disgrace.'

title: World War II Memorial on National Mall vandalized with pink spray paint; fountain overflowing with bubbles
summary: Pink spray paint graffiti that said "clean hands, dirty money" was found on the World War II Memorial, and U.S. Park Police launched an investigation.

title: Fountains at World War II memorial overflow with soap bubbles
summary: The Interior Department is investigating vandalism at the World War II Memorial in Washington, DC, after neon graffiti was painted on the Atlantic Pavilion and the usually clear fountains overflowed with soapy bubbles.
